title: Singular values and area: σ₁σ₂ = |det A| = 15
caption: A = [[3, 0], [4, 5]] turns the unit square into a parallelogram of area 15. The singular values σ₁ = √45 ≈ 6.708 and σ₂ = √5 ≈ 2.236 are the stretches along its two perpendicular axes, and their product is the area scale factor.
alt: The unit square and its image under A, a parallelogram with vertices (0, 0), (3, 4), (3, 9), (0, 5) and area 15.
description: A sends (1, 0) to (3, 4) and (0, 1) to (0, 5), so the image has corners (0, 0), (3, 4), (3, 9), (0, 5).
Its area is |det A| = 15, and σ₁σ₂ = √45 × √5 = √225 = 15.

checks.name: the image has 15 times the area: σ₁σ₂ = √45 × √5 = 15 = |det A|
